mechanisms.title: Shipping Condition Derivation
mechanisms.memory_hook: Shipping condition is a service-level input, not a route by itself.
mechanisms.question: Which shipping condition enters shipping-point and route determination?

inputs.name: shipping condition on sales document type
shipping condition for ship-to sales-area data

mechanisms.determination: The shipping condition is copied into the sales document header from customer master data unless the sales document type supplies its own value. If both are maintained, the sales document type value has priority.

failure_modes.prove: Prove the shipping condition source first: sales document type versus ship-to master data.
Check whether the sales document type carries a shipping condition that overrides the customer value.

tests.setup: Maintain one shipping condition for the ship-to and a different one on the sales document type.
tests.assert: The sales document header uses the sales-document-type value and downstream shipping logic consumes it.

mechanisms.title: Material Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: The material typed by the user is not always the material that survives the order.
mechanisms.question: Should the entered material be replaced or should substitute products be proposed?

inputs.name: sales document type and assigned material-determination procedure

mechanisms.determination: Material determination uses the condition technique. The procedure assigned to the sales document type drives condition-type and access-sequence searches for a valid replacement or substitution record.
outputs: subitem structure depending on substitution outcome
configuration_surfaces: Assign procedures to sales document types

failure_modes.prove: Check document-type procedure assignment → condition type → access sequence → condition record validity → substitution reason.

failure_modes.symptom: Wrong product replaces the entered one
failure_modes.prove: Trace the successful access and substitution reason before changing product master data or ATP.

tests.setup: Maintain one valid substitution record and assign the procedure to one sales document type but not another.
tests.assert: Substitution runs only for the document type with an active procedure and valid record.

mechanisms.title: Material Listing and Exclusion
mechanisms.memory_hook: Before pricing a material, SAP may first decide whether the customer is allowed to buy it.
mechanisms.question: Is this material allowed for this customer context?
mechanisms.determination: Listing and exclusion checks condition records during item entry. A listing restricts the customer to allowed products; an exclusion blocks maintained products.

failure_modes.symptom: Material is rejected although it exists and is sellable
failure_modes.prove: Run listing/exclusion analysis and check the customer/partner key and valid condition record.

failure_modes.symptom: Restricted customer can order an unexpected material
failure_modes.prove: Check whether a listing exists for the relevant partner and whether the record is valid for the order date/context.

tests.setup: Create a customer listing that contains product A but not product B.
tests.assert: A is accepted and B is rejected according to the maintained listing.

mechanisms.title: Free Goods Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: A promotion can create document structure, not just a discount line.
mechanisms.question: Does this order quantity qualify for an inclusive or exclusive free-goods item?
mechanisms.determination: When the configured prerequisites and a valid free-goods record match, the system creates a free-of-charge subitem. Inclusive free goods reduce the paid/main quantity; exclusive free goods add quantity on top.

failure_modes.symptom: Promotion record exists but no free item is created
failure_modes.prove: Check process support → record validity → quantity threshold → free-goods settings → resulting subitem category.

failure_modes.symptom: Customer receives the wrong total quantity
failure_modes.prove: Prove whether the agreement is inclusive or exclusive before changing pricing or delivery logic.

tests.setup: Maintain a threshold-based free-goods agreement and create orders just below and at the threshold.
tests.assert: The free item appears only when the configured qualification is met and quantity behavior matches inclusive/exclusive design.

mechanisms.title: Tax Determination in Sales Pricing
mechanisms.memory_hook: Tax is pricing logic with localization attached, which is where the simplicity ends.
mechanisms.question: Which tax condition and rate apply to this sales item?

inputs.name: pricing procedure and tax condition types
tax condition records / jurisdiction inputs where applicable

mechanisms.determination: Sales tax is evaluated inside pricing. Condition records use business-document fields such as country/region and customer/material tax classifications. Exact tax types, jurisdiction logic and required keys are localization-specific.
outputs: tax code or jurisdiction result where applicable

failure_modes.prove: Separate pricing-procedure placement from localization: prove tax condition type → access keys → origin/destination → customer/material classification → record validity.

failure_modes.symptom: Same customer/material gets different tax in another flow
failure_modes.prove: Compare departure/destination and localization/jurisdiction inputs before treating it as a pricing defect.

tests.setup: Keep material constant and vary one controlled tax-relevant master-data or geography input in a configured country scenario.
tests.assert: The tax condition result changes according to the maintained condition record and localization rules.

mechanisms.title: Delivery Item Category Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: The sales item starts the story; the delivery item category decides how shipping executes it.
mechanisms.question: Which delivery item category controls this delivery item?

inputs.name: material item category group
inputs.origin: product master, for deliveries without order reference

mechanisms.determination: With order reference, the delivery item category is normally copied from the order item. For a delivery without order reference, the system proposes it from delivery type and material item-category group.

failure_modes.symptom: Delivery item is not pick relevant or storage location is not requested
failure_modes.prove: Prove the delivery item category and its controls before debugging warehouse execution.

failure_modes.symptom: Unexpected category in delivery without order reference
failure_modes.prove: Trace delivery type + material item-category group determination.

tests.setup: Create one delivery with order reference and one allowed delivery without order reference for the same material context.
tests.assert: Referenced flow follows copied item-category behavior; non-referenced flow follows delivery-type/item-category-group determination.

mechanisms.title: Picking Storage Location Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Plant chooses the site. Picking location chooses the stock room that ships.
mechanisms.question: From which storage location should the delivery item be picked?
mechanisms.determination: During delivery creation, automatic picking-location determination can use shipping point + plant + storage condition. Delivery type and delivery item category control whether and how automatic storage-location determination runs.

failure_modes.symptom: Delivery has no picking storage location
failure_modes.prove: Check delivery item category requirement → delivery-type rule → shipping point + plant + storage condition assignment.
Prove the storage condition and picking-location assignment before changing stock or batch settings.

tests.setup: Use one plant/shipping point with products carrying different storage conditions mapped to different picking locations.
tests.assert: Delivery items receive the configured storage location according to shipping point + plant + storage condition.

mechanisms.title: Revenue Account Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Pricing decides the amount. Account determination decides where finance puts it.
mechanisms.question: Which G/L revenue or sales-deduction account receives this billing amount?
mechanisms.determination: Revenue account determination uses the condition technique. The procedure and access sequence search account-determination condition records using billing and master-data keys until a valid G/L account is found.
configuration_surfaces: Customer and material account assignment groups

failure_modes.symptom: Billing posts to the wrong revenue account
failure_modes.prove: Trace chart of accounts → sales org → customer/material account assignment groups → pricing account key → successful account-determination access.

failure_modes.symptom: Billing cannot post to FI because account is missing
failure_modes.prove: Use account determination analysis and prove the exact missing key combination before creating a broader fallback record.

tests.setup: Keep the billing flow constant and vary one account-assignment group with distinct maintained condition records.
tests.assert: The posted revenue account changes according to the successful access without changing the commercial price.
